name: NoKillmoves
summary: SKSE plugin for Skyrim: travel with up to 20 followers and 20 animal companions using the vanilla follower dialogue
description:
NoKillmoves lets you switch kill moves on/off for yourself and for NPCs, and optionaly kill cam too. The idea is to get rid of VioLens dependency from my modlist.

[line]

[size=4][b]Feature[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][color=#d9a05b][b]bDisablePlayerThirdPerson = true[/b][/color]
your kill moves in third person.[/*]
[*][color=#d9a05b][b]bDisablePlayerFirstPerson = true[/b][/color]
your kill moves in first person.[/*]
[*][color=#d9a05b][b]bDisableNPC = true[/b][/color]
kill moves by NPCs, creatures and dragons on you.[/*]
[*][color=#d9a05b][b]bDisableNPCOnNPC = true[/b][/color]
kill moves by NPCs, creatures and dragons on each other.[/*]
[*][color=#d9a05b][b]bDisableKillMoveCam = false[/b][/color]
the camera during your melee kill moves. The kill move still plays.[/*]
[*][color=#d9a05b][b]bDisableMagicKillCam = true[/b][/color]
the slow-motion when your spell kills the last enemy.[/*]
[*][color=#d9a05b][b]bDisableBowKillCam = false[/b][/color]
the slow-motion camera that follows your arrow.[/*]
[/list]

[line]

[size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]

[i]Mod Control Panel > NoKillmoves[/i] (SKSE Menu Framework), or [i]SKSE/Plugins/NoKillmoves.ini[/i].

[line]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://skse.silverlock.org/]SKSE[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/32444]Address Library for SKSE Plugins[/url][/*]
[*][i]Recommended:[/i] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/120352]SKSE Menu Framework[/url] (without it, use the INI)[/*]
[/list]

[size=2][color=#9a9a9a]Tested on Skyrim AE 1.6.1170. Built for SE and AE; VR is untested.[/color][/size]

[line]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]


The kill cam switches take priority over [i]bVATSDisable[/i] in your [i]Skyrim.ini[/i],

Kill move animation packs that add to the vanilla kill move lists are covered too.

[color=#e07b67][b]Other kill move or kill cam managers[/b][/color] (VioLens, Kaputt, Disable Kill Cam And Kill Moves...) have their own switches. Use one or the other.

[line]

[size=4][b]FAQ[/b][/size]

[b]Will I still get sneak kills?[/b]
Yes. The throat slit stays

[b]Do NPC switches cover dragons and creatures?[/b]
Yes. Bears, sabre cats, trolls, dragons and the rest all count as NPCs here.

[b]What about werewolf and vampire lord kills?[/b]
They count as your third person kill moves, so that switch covers them.

[b]Install or remove mid-game?[/b]
Any time. It saves nothing in your save file.

[b]Reporting a bug[/b]
Post your [i]Documents/My Games/Skyrim Special Edition/SKSE/NoKillmoves.log[/i] (via Pastebin) in the [b]Bugs[/b] tab with what you did and what you expected.
